has_own_site_check.conclusion: No owned domain found anywhere. Every public presence is GlossGenius, a directory/aggregator, or social media. has_own_site = false confirmed.

address.how_resolved: GlossGenius' own live booking site (self-fetched HTML, embedded JSON streetAddress field) and Fresha (independent third-party booking platform) both independently agree on 2950 Immokalee Road #3, Naples FL 34110. This conflicts with older aggregator listings (Birdeye, Yelp updated Nov 2025, a Bayfront Salon Suites Facebook post) that show 1333 3rd Ave S, Ste 16, Naples FL 34102. A timestamp inside the GlossGenius page payload (created_at: 2026-06-06) plus a WebSearch snippet mentioning Scalp Bar 'opening a new location in Naples in June' indicates the business relocated from the Bayfront Salon Suites (3rd Ave S) address to Immokalee Road around June 2026, and the older aggregators simply have not caught up yet. The two live, business-controlled booking platforms (GlossGenius direct + Fresha) were treated as the current source of truth over the stale directory caches.

reviews_used_on_site.author: Judy E
reviews_used_on_site.text: I had the 'ultimate' scalp service with Monica. She's incredibly knowledgeable and so very nice. I learned a lot and really loved the treatment. Besides my hair, I received a very relaxing facial. I highly recommend.

reviews_used_on_site.author: Stephanie Marie Narvaez
reviews_used_on_site.text: Scalp Bar Head Spa is absolutely amazing! I booked an appointment with Bailey, and she is truly the sweetest and most knowledgeable person I have ever met. She took the time to explain everything detail by detail. I left feeling relaxed and completely educated on how to care for my scalp.

reviews_used_on_site.author: Ethan Klein
reviews_used_on_site.text: Not very often do you experience something so informative as well as so deeply relaxing. Bailey did an amazing job.

images.source: Two sources: (1) scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway cloud service) pulled 12 real IG feed photos/video-covers to output/scalp-bar-naples/assets/raw/bk-1..12.jpg; (2) GlossGenius booking page's own embedded service/cover photos (static.glossgenius.com URLs), downloaded directly via curl, 13 images. All verified as valid JPEG/PNG via PIL.
images.curation_note: Strict visual curation per DESIGN.md. Of the 12 IG photos, 8 were disqualified: bk-1, bk-5, bk-6, bk-7, bk-9, bk-10, bk-12 all had baked-in text/caption overlays ('ANNUAL SUMMER SPECIAL', 'Scalp Bar Naples FL' watermark, 'REAL CLIENT STORY', 'Time to relax' script, 'Mother's Day Gift Certificates', a K18 product ad graphic, closed-eyes-with-caption selfie-style shot). bk-2 (a genuinely great real interior shot of the styling stations) had a 'WE DON'T ANSWER THE PHONE' text overlay across the middle: cropped to its clean top 42% (vanity/mirror/lamps, no text) rather than discarded, since the underlying photo was too good to waste. bk-3, bk-4, bk-8, bk-11 were clean (no text) but were near-duplicate teal-eye-mask/blue-light treatment shots; bk-4 alone was kept (as 'gallery-steam.jpg') for variety. The GlossGenius-hosted photos (professional business-owned shots, no text overlays, no selfie framing) supplied the rest: hero, both Experience-section photos, and 3 of the 5 gallery tiles. No selfie/owner-portrait was used as a gallery tile; the one used as the small circular nav/footer logo (per DESIGN.md's explicit allowance for a small avatar) is a tight crop, not a gallery tile.

brand_vibe: Dark, moody boutique spa: charcoal/black walls, brass and gold fixtures (patterned lampshades, the gold 'halo' water-ritual device used in every treatment photo), cognac leather styling chairs, teal patterned eye masks as a small accent color. Base kept DARK (templates/dark-v2) to match. Accent hue-shifted from the skeleton's original gold (~H40) by -16 degrees to a warm copper/bronze (~H24-25), nodding to the real brass fixtures and halo device while staying distinct from every gold/red/coral/teal/violet palette already used elsewhere in this project.
base_template: templates/dark-v2 (dark base, pureartistry exemplar, EN default)

palette.derivation: All 27 hex tokens and 11 rgba() families in templates/dark-v2/index.html hue-shifted programmatically by a fixed -16deg HSL hue delta, preserving each token's original saturation/lightness. The merktop-badge block (CSS + footer HTML, including the uppercase #D4A84B dot and #f4eee2 text color) was extracted and protected before the palette replace, then restored untouched.

jsonld_type_note: Used @type: HealthAndBeautyBusiness (per task instructions), a valid schema.org LocalBusiness subtype fitting a head/scalp spa. hasOfferCatalog lists the 4 highlighted real services with real prices.
build_method: Anchored transformation script (Python, rep()/rep_all() with assert-before-replace, whole-section reconstruction via unique HTML-comment anchors) over templates/dark-v2/index.html per templates/SKELETONS-V2.md, script at scripts/build_scalpbarnaples.py. index.html was never written from scratch.

manual_qa: Rendered locally with Playwright (Chromium headless) at desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce (to force scroll-reveal elements visible for review) plus a full programmatic scroll-through pass (to trigger lazy-loaded images). Confirmed: zero horizontal overflow on mobile (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390), all 8 real curated photos load and display correctly in hero/experience/gallery, no <details>/accordion anywhere, services menu fully visible with no collapse, language toggle (EN<->ES) verified working (h1, nav, hero, services, footer all switch correctly, <html lang> updates), footer 'Powered by Merktop' badge intact and gold, contrast good throughout (light ink on dark charcoal/copper band).
